meta.description: Custom sandbox blueprint for real-time PHP diagnostics, database stress testing, hooks inspection, and memory limit analysis.

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: WP Performance Sandbox
 * Description: Real PHP, DB, Hooks and Memory diagnostics.
 * Version: 0.4.2
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) exit;

$GLOBALS['wps_php_runtime_issues'] = [];

add_action( 'muplugins_loaded', function () {
	set_error_handler( function ( $errno, $message, $file, $line ) {
		if ( ! in_array( $errno, [ E_WARNING, E_NOTICE, E_USER_WARNING, E_USER_NOTICE, E_DEPRECATED, E_USER_DEPRECATED ], true ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		$GLOBALS['wps_php_runtime_issues'][] = [
			'type'    => wps_php_error_type( $errno ),
			'message' => $message,
			'file'    => $file,
			'line'    => (int) $line,
		];
		return false;
	} );
} );

add_action( 'shutdown', function () {
	if ( empty( $GLOBALS['wps_php_runtime_issues'] ) ) return;
	update_option( 'wps_php_runtime_issues', array_slice( $GLOBALS['wps_php_runtime_issues'], -80 ), false );
}, PHP_INT_MAX );

function wps_php_error_type( $errno ) {
	$map = [
		E_WARNING => 'Warning', E_NOTICE => 'Notice',
		E_USER_WARNING => 'User warning', E_USER_NOTICE => 'User notice',
		E_DEPRECATED => 'Deprecated', E_USER_DEPRECATED => 'User deprecated',
	];
	return $map[ $errno ] ?? 'PHP diagnostic';
}

add_action( 'rest_api_init', function () {
	foreach ( [
		'/php-errors' => 'wps_php_errors_test',
		'/db-stress'  => 'wps_db_stress_test',
		'/hooks'      => 'wps_hooks_test',
		'/memory'     => 'wps_memory_test',
	] as $route => $cb ) {
		register_rest_route( 'wp-performance-sandbox/v1', $route, [
			'methods'             => 'GET',
			'callback'            => $cb,
			'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
		] );
	}
} );

function wps_php_errors_test() {
	$started = microtime( true );
	$runtime = get_option( 'wps_php_runtime_issues', [] );
	if ( ! is_array( $runtime ) ) $runtime = [];

	$deprecated = [];
	$roots = [ WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/plugins', WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/themes' ];
	$funcs = [ 'utf8_encode' => 'utf8_encode()', 'utf8_decode' => 'utf8_decode()' ];
	$scanned_count = 0;
	$max_files = 150;

	foreach ( $roots as $root ) {
		if ( ! is_dir( $root ) ) continue;
		try {
			$it = new RecursiveIteratorIterator( new RecursiveDirectoryIterator( $root, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS ) );
			foreach ( $it as $file ) {
				if ( $scanned_count >= $max_files ) break 2;
				if ( ! $file->isFile() || strtolower( $file->getExtension() ) !== 'php' ) continue;
				$scanned_count++;
				$content = @file_get_contents( $file->getPathname() );
				if ( false === $content ) continue;
				foreach ( $funcs as $needle => $label ) {
					if ( false !== stripos( $content, $needle . '(' ) ) {
						$deprecated[] = [
							'type' => 'Deprecated',
							'message' => 'Found ' . $label,
							'file' => str_replace( ABSPATH, '/', $file->getPathname() ),
							'line' => 0,
						];
					}
				}
			}
		} catch ( Throwable $e ) {}
	}

	return rest_ensure_response( [
		'ok' => true,
		'php_version' => PHP_VERSION,
		'elapsed_ms' => round( ( microtime( true ) - $started ) * 1000, 2 ),
		'runtime_issues' => array_slice( $runtime, -50 ),
		'deprecated' => $deprecated,
		'explanation' => 'This test looks for warnings and old functions in the code. It helps detect compatibility problems before they cause visible errors.',
	] );
}

function wps_db_stress_test() {
	global $wpdb;
	$started = microtime( true );
	$table = $wpdb->prefix . 'wps_stress_tmp';
	$rows = 400;
	$queries = 0;
	$status = 'ok';
	$message = '';

	try {
		$wpdb->query( "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{$table}`" ); $queries++;
		$wpdb->query( "CREATE TABLE `{$table}` (
			id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
			payload VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (id)
		) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4" ); $queries++;

		$values = [];
		for ( $i = 0; $i < $rows; $i++ ) {
			$values[] = $wpdb->prepare( '(%s)', 's' . $i . '-' . wp_generate_password( 8, false ) );
		}
		foreach ( array_chunk( $values, 40 ) as $chunk ) {
			$wpdb->query( "INSERT INTO `{$table}` (payload) VALUES " . implode( ',', $chunk ) );
			$queries++;
		}

		$wpdb->get_results( "SELECT * FROM `{$table}` ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50" ); $queries++;
		$wpdb->get_var( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{$table}`" ); $queries++;
		$wpdb->query( "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{$table}`" ); $queries++;

		$message = "Inserted {$rows} rows and ran the queries successfully.";
	} catch ( Throwable $e ) {
		$status = 'error';
		$message = $e->getMessage();
		@$wpdb->query( "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{$table}`" );
	}

	$elapsed = round( ( microtime( true ) - $started ) * 1000, 2 );
	$qps = $elapsed > 0 ? round( $queries / ( $elapsed / 1000 ), 1 ) : 0;

	return rest_ensure_response( [
		'ok' => $status === 'ok',
		'elapsed_ms' => $elapsed,
		'queries' => $queries,
		'qps' => $qps,
		'rows' => $rows,
		'message' => $message,
		'explanation' => 'This test simulates real work on the database to measure its speed. It helps you know if WordPress can handle many operations without becoming slow.',
	] );
}

function wps_hooks_test() {
	global $wp_filter;
	$started = microtime( true );
	$total_hooks = 0;
	$total_callbacks = 0;
	$heavy = [];

	if ( is_array( $wp_filter ) ) {
		foreach ( $wp_filter as $tag => $hook ) {
			$total_hooks++;
			$count = 0;
			if ( isset( $hook->callbacks ) && is_array( $hook->callbacks ) ) {
				foreach ( $hook->callbacks as $cbs ) {
					$count += count( $cbs );
				}
			}
			$total_callbacks += $count;
			if ( $count >= 12 ) {
				$heavy[] = [ 'hook' => $tag, 'callbacks' => $count ];
			}
		}
	}
	usort( $heavy, fn( $a, $b ) => $b['callbacks'] - $a['callbacks'] );
	$heavy = array_slice( $heavy, 0, 6 );

	return rest_ensure_response( [
		'ok' => true,
		'elapsed_ms' => round( ( microtime( true ) - $started ) * 1000, 2 ),
		'total_hooks' => $total_hooks,
		'total_callbacks' => $total_callbacks,
		'heavy_hooks' => $heavy,
		'explanation' => 'This test counts how many hooks and filters WordPress has registered. Too many callbacks on the same hook can slow down the site.',
	] );
}

function wps_memory_test() {
	$started = microtime( true );
	$dummy = [];
	for ( $i = 0; $i < 3000; $i++ ) {
		$dummy[] = str_repeat( 'x', 100 );
	}
	unset( $dummy );

	return rest_ensure_response( [
		'ok' => true,
		'elapsed_ms' => round( ( microtime( true ) - $started ) * 1000, 2 ),
		'php_memory_limit' => ini_get( 'memory_limit' ),
		'wp_memory_limit' => defined( 'WP_MEMORY_LIMIT' ) ? WP_MEMORY_LIMIT : 'not defined',
		'wp_max_memory_limit' => defined( 'WP_MAX_MEMORY_LIMIT' ) ? WP_MAX_MEMORY_LIMIT : 'not defined',
		'usage_now' => size_format( memory_get_usage( true ) ),
		'peak' => size_format( memory_get_peak_usage( true ) ),
		'explanation' => 'This test shows how much memory PHP has available and how much WordPress is currently using. It helps detect if the site is close to the limit.',
	] );
}

options.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$content = getenv('CONTENT');

remove_all_filters('content_save_pre');
remove_all_filters('content_filtered_save_pre');
remove_all_filters('excerpt_save_pre');
remove_all_filters('pre_comment_content');
remove_all_filters('pre_user_description');

$page_id = wp_insert_post([
	'post_title'   => 'WP Debug Lab',
	'post_content' => $content,
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'post_name'    => 'wp-debug-lab',
]);

if ( $page_id && ! is_wp_error( $page_id ) ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );
	update_option( 'blogname', 'WP Debug Lab' );
}
